purpose: Stage-by-stage acceptance matrix for authorized voice, avatar, lip-sync and live presentation.
important: These are test definitions, not test results. All stages remain NOT_RUN until evidence is captured from the real provider and deployed environment.

stages.purpose: Confirm the selected voice is owned by or explicitly authorized by the subject and is available through the permitted provider workflow.
pass_criteria: Authorization evidence is recorded without exposing private identity documents.
Provider resource ID and connection status are captured.
A short sample can be generated and played back.
No API key or secret appears in browser code, logs, or evidence.

stages.purpose: Exercise fixed Hindi and English prompts against the approved voice pipeline.
pass_criteria: At least 5 versioned prompts per supported language are run.
Prompt, response, duration, and error are logged under the same test ID.
Answers are checked for factual support and clearly stated uncertainty.
Generated speech is reviewed for intelligibility and unauthorized voice substitution.

stages.purpose: Ensure the spoken script separates sourced facts, interpretation, and personal philosophy.
pass_criteria: Material factual claims have traceable sources.
Uncertainty and meaningful counterviews are included where relevant.
The 99.9999% / 0.0001% ratio is labelled a philosophical target, not a scientifically measured score.
Hindi and English renderings preserve meaning without adding unsupported claims.

stages.purpose: Verify the provider uses the already supplied, authorized avatar asset; do not request the user to upload the same photo or video again.
pass_criteria: Existing provider asset ID is resolved in the authenticated account.
Asset identity and permitted use are reviewed.
Consent and retention/deletion rules are recorded.
Only the minimum required asset reference is included in logs.

stages.purpose: Generate and review a short clip using the authorized voice and avatar.
pass_criteria: The generated clip and source audio share a correlation test ID.
Speech content matches the approved script.
Reviewer records synchronization, pronunciation, visual artifacts, and audio quality.
Synthetic-media disclosure is present where viewers could mistake it for a real live recording.

stages.purpose: Verify an actual interactive provider session, not a prerecorded avatar video.
pass_criteria: A real session ID and provider request/response trace are captured.
At least 5 live questions are submitted and responses are recorded.
Latency, interruption, timeout, and recovery behavior are measured.
The interface clearly distinguishes live interaction from prerecorded playback.

stages.purpose: Prove the complete Voice → Authorized Voice → Test Q&A → Evidence-backed Content → Authorized Face → Lip-sync → Live Presentation chain.
pass_criteria: Every stage passes in the same correlated test run.
Evidence references and timestamps connect all stage records.
Production deployment commit and URL are recorded.
A second reviewer can reproduce the test and inspect the evidence.

must_not_infer_success_from: A workflow run without provider traces
A local test without deployed URL verification
current_blockers: No real provider traces were supplied in this change.
No completed live session evidence is recorded here.
No deployed end-to-end verification is recorded here.
